• 	1. 	Regulating blood volume and pressure
• 	2. 	Regulating plasma concentrations of sodium,
potassium, chloride and other ions
• 	3. 	Stabilising blood pH
• 	4. 	Conserving nutrients
• 	5. 	Detoxifying poisons (with the liver)
